# Intellipaat

> > Intellipaat is a professional learning platform offering certifications, degree programs, and corporate training in data science, AI, cloud computing, and emerging technologies through partnerships with IITs, NITs, and international institutions.

Intellipaat provides comprehensive professional development through online courses, degree programs (M.Tech, M.Sc, MS), and executive certifications in collaboration with premier institutions like IIT Roorkee, IIT Indore, NIT Sikkim, and IIM Ranchi. The platform serves working professionals, enterprises, and students seeking skill advancement in AI, data science, cloud computing, cybersecurity, and product management.

## Key Topics

- Data Science
- Machine Learning
- Generative AI
- Cloud Computing
- DevOps
- Cyber Security
- Python
- IIT Roorkee
- IIT Indore
- NIT Sikkim
- IIM Ranchi
- Executive Certifications

## Degree Programs & Advanced Certifications

- [M.Tech in Computer Science (Executive) from NIT Sikkim](https://intellipaat.com/mtech-computer-science-nit-sikkim): Executive M.Tech in Computer Science from NIT Sikkim with AI and cybersecurity specializations.
- [M.Sc in Applied AI (Online) by NIT Sikkim](https://intellipaat.com/msc-applied-ai): Online M.Sc in Applied AI from NIT Sikkim covering ML, DL, NLP with weekend classes.
- [MS in Data Science & AI in Europe](https://intellipaat.com/ms-data-science-europe): Master's degree in data science and AI offered in Europe with ECTS credits.
- [Doctor of Business Administration Degree Program](https://intellipaat.com/doctor-of-business-administration): DBA degree program from Swiss School of Business and Management, Geneva.
- [Intellipaat School of Technology IST](https://intellipaat.com/ist): 4-year undergraduate engineering program with IIT faculty and university partnerships.

## IIT-Backed Professional Certifications

- [Data Science Course Online with IIT Certification](https://intellipaat.com/data-scientist-course-training): Data science course with IIT Roorkee certification covering Python, ML, AI, statistics.
- [Advanced Certification in DevOps and Cloud Computing](https://intellipaat.com/advanced-certification-devops-cloud-computing): Advanced DevOps and cloud computing certification by IIT Madras covering AWS, Kubernetes.
- [EPG Certification in Data Science and AI - IIT Roorkee iHUB](https://intellipaat.com/epgc-data-science-ai-ihubds-iit-roorkee): Executive postgraduate certification in data science and AI by IIT Roorkee iHUB.
- [Executive Post Graduate Certification in Cyber Security - iHUB IIT Roorkee](https://intellipaat.com/epgc-ethical-hacking-ihub-iit-roorkee): Cybersecurity and ethical hacking certification by IIT Roorkee iHUB with EC Council.
- [Generative AI and Machine Learning Course - IIT Certification](https://intellipaat.com/generative-ai-machine-learning-course): Generative AI and ML course by IIT Indore covering prompt engineering, Python, deep learning.
- [AI & Data Science from DRISHTI CPS, IIT Indore](https://intellipaat.com/ai-data-science-drishti-iit-indore): AI and data science program from IIT Indore DRISHTI CPS with academic credits.
- [EPGC in Electric Vehicle Design - IIT Roorkee iHUB](https://intellipaat.com/epgc-electric-vehicle-design-ihub-iit-roorkee): Executive certification in electric vehicle design with MATLAB and powertrain skills.

## Executive & Leadership Programs

- [Product Management Course by IIM Ranchi](https://intellipaat.com/product-management-course-certification): Product management course by IIM Ranchi covering strategy, agile, and industry tools.
- [Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO) - IIM Ranchi](https://intellipaat.com/chro-course): CHRO certification by IIM Ranchi covering talent management and HR leadership.

## Online Learning & Training

- [Online Professional Training Courses and Certification](https://intellipaat.com): Intellipaat homepage offering professional certification courses in data science, AI, cloud computing, and DevOps.
- [Free Online Courses with Certificates - Intellipaat Academy](https://intellipaat.com/academy): Free online courses in Python, Data Science, AWS, and AI/ML with certificate offerings.
- [Corporate Training Companies - Corporate Training Program Courses](https://intellipaat.com/corporate-training): Corporate training programs in AI, data science, business analytics, cloud computing.

## Talent & Hiring Solutions

- [Hire From Us - Intellipaat](https://intellipaat.com/hire-from-us): Hiring platform offering pre-qualified candidates in data science, cloud, AI/ML, programming.
